title: The visible CFPB complaint-response endpoint changed over time
source_unit: published CFPB complaint record grouped by calendar year received

observations.method: Official CFPB API aggregate query for date_received_min=2020-01-01, date_received_max=2021-01-01, size=0
observations.uncertainty: No sampling standard error estimated; published-record selection and coding uncertainty remain.
observations.counterinterpretation: Later-year response shares may reflect product, routing, publication, and coding changes rather than improved or worsened consumer remedies.

observations.counterinterpretation: The 2025 shift toward explanation and away from non-monetary or monetary response categories may reflect product mix, routing, publication, coding, or index changes rather than a change in verified consumer remedies.

boundary: This is a trend in published complaint-system records. It is not a representative consumer sample, account-denominated harm rate, verified remedy rate, trust measure, switching measure, or causal estimate.
